title: Number of Singaporeans and PRs who Have Applied for Temporary Relief Fund for COVID-19 Situation
what_it_is: Number of Singaporeans and PRs who Have Applied for Temporary Relief Fund for COVID-19 Situation

sections.label: Temporary Relief Fund applications and returns
sections.summary: MSF received 537,080 Temporary Relief Fund applications as at 30 April 2020, with 3,171 individuals returning payouts; abuse may constitute cheating.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As at 30 April 2020, MSF has received a total 537,080 applications for the Temporary Relief Fund.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Of this figure, 3,171 individuals have returned their payouts from the Fund.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Abuse of the Temporary Relief Fund may constitute an offence of cheating, which is punishable with imprisonment for a term of up to 10 years, a fine or both.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Where individuals returned their cheques or payouts, this will be a mitigating factor in our assessment of fraudulent claims.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Individuals should return their cheques or payouts by the end May 2020.
